question:
When the mirror is placed to the right of the given figure, select the correct image of the figure formed in the mirror.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f33a94302215891385df942db9a136ff827832a37c19940f22e44a1e85e5061.png]
solution:
The correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at PQ is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca09b0679d7c70dc4d1ab407acc9079b0551ad673d2f9c633201496c1ad1cc99.png] 

__Detailed Explanation:__

 
• The line PQ is the mirror.
 
• The numbers placed in right column is "2, 5, 6". So in mirror image right column will be seen as left column and mirror image of '2' is " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b460ac8e015556dd0af1df438314e6e6d82d3f13ce4e2905f9c88f730d2d6f5.png] " ⇒ Option 1 and 2 are eliminated.
 
• The numbers placed in right column is "2, 5, 6". So in mirror image right column will be seen as left column and mirror image of '6' is " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fcfec120c33a76303be25c3cd9f72462b322357729f9ee78c8e13a756085628.png] " ⇒ Option 3 is eliminated.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
